name: Manaforge Duro
shortDescription: Manaforge Duro, a named setting in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: Site of the delivered surveying equipment and the blood elves’ reported mana-creature infestation. Its story art is interpretive; no exact map coordinate, dungeon floor plan or travel route is asserted. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
